item.description:
Synopsis:​
Familiar duo Mordecai and Rigby navigate mundane park jobs that inevitably spiral into surreal, chaotic disasters.
Click to expand...
NOTE: Contains these currently available audio tracks on HBO Max:
English [Original], Bulgarian, Cantonese, Chinese, Croatian, Czech, Danish, Dutch, Finnish, French, German, Hungarian, Indonesian, Italian, Malay, Norwegian, Polish, Portuguese (Brazil) [5.1], Portuguese (Portugal), Romanian, Serbian, Slovenian, Spanish (Latin America) [5.1], Spanish (Spain), Swedish, Thai and Turkish
Click to expand...
These audio tracks are all synced to the RAWR WEB-DL files, as they have a higher video bitrate. Although a thread already exists for this show, I thought people would want to download the show with the other audio tracks for those who prefer that.

"Fix That Tape" and "Skips' Luau" are separated in this release to match TheTVDB and TheMovieDB's API, and I also took the liberty of fixing the syncing of the subtitles with the video of both episodes.

The season is currently ongoing, so the folder will be updated with new episodes as more come out. They will all be available on here once all audio tracks are released for each episode. So far as of May 12th, 2026, the Asia Pacific region has released up to episode 4, "Nap Spot", so this folder will be available up to that.

Please note that some of these episodes were censored in certain regions (not all of them) with missing scenes, so audio tracks will be labeled with "CENSORED" if English audio is ever present in cut scenes.
